author: Whale__Warrior
body:
So i've had a good CTH map idea but im not the best maker so....
It's a large bowl (which could be half a sphere if you use world edit) about 1/3 of the bowl would be filled with red blocks to make it look like looks like tomato soup (obviously not just one block a bunch of red blocks to give it texture) the soup won't just be flat because that would be boring and wont get the map accepted.
All thats left is the spawns, for theese i think you could do 4 spoons made out of iron with the teams coloured stripe on the end. There would be about a 10 block drop from the spoon to the bowl(they don't take fall damage),
What do you think?
And if any willing map devs or good builders read this be sure to have a go!
